given.note: A6-32: Alex opens his one pay link, rosfield.com/p/f4, 78 minutes after it went (charge-failed-pay-link.json). The pay page's server reads the payment by the effect row's providerObjectId on Lee's Barbershop's account, from Rosie's own record and not from the link: it still needs a card, so the answer carries the client secret for the page's Stripe form and the $25 it takes. The deadline, 17:00Z, is the clock row's; Alex pays at 16:20Z (double-signed-webhook.json).
